note: Hardy entries pulled from four DCIAA-wide records documents given to Dario by another middle school coach. Each source is a league-wide YEARLY-CHAMPION ledger (one row per event per year: who won it, what mark) - not full meet results with every finisher - so these can confirm or flag Hardy's own record wall, but can't be turned into per-meet result files the way TFRRS/athletic.net captures can. They also predate this site's meet-by-meet captures, covering roughly 2007/08-2015/16.
